Website information

Accessibility & privacy

How this website concept handles access, information accuracy, imagery and personal data.

AccessibilityPrivacyPublication statusImage rights

Accessibility

The site is designed with semantic headings, keyboard-accessible navigation, readable colour contrast, descriptive image text and reduced-motion support. Visitors who encounter an accessibility problem should use the contact page and select “Website correction.”

Privacy

The current static concept does not use analytics cookies, advertising trackers or account registration. The contact form demonstrates the intended workflow but does not transmit or store personal data until the club confirms an official recipient and privacy process.

Publication status

This website is a design and implementation concept prepared by AstraMind Labs. It is not presented as an authorised official club publication. Leadership, squad, commercial and operational information should receive club approval before public launch.

Image rights

Campaign photography is credited in the supplied profile to MBC. The historical squad image accompanies The Maravi Post’s 2021 promotion report. Images are used here for design review; further public reuse should follow the relevant permissions.

Corrections

Football records should remain dated and attributable. If a name, score, venue or role is incorrect, submit a correction with supporting evidence through the contact page.
